_comment: Data-driven workflow registry (spec section 23). `level` is one of MICRO|FEATURE|BUSINESS|CROSS_MODULE|FULL_LIFECYCLE. Each step's `check` is interpreted by src/workflow-engine/runWorkflows.js against the real discovery evidence - route/table/state/event names here must exist in the actual repo, they are not invented. `phase` is informational metadata only (section 3): it never limits which workflows the engine can run.

workflows.name: Cart line-item re-pricing lookup
workflows.startingCondition: Cart contents exist client-side in localStorage (no server-side cart table).

steps.description: Page requests authoritative price/stock/title for the variant ids in the cart
Server reads current variant price/stock and filters to published products only

failureScenarios: A variant id no longer exists or its product was unpublished since being added to cart
recoveryScenarios: Route filters unpublished products out of the response rather than erroring (server/src/routes/public.js cart-items handler)

workflows.name: Wishlist add / persist / view / remove

steps.description: Login required before any wishlist action
Add a product to the wishlist
Wishlist item persisted
Remove a wishlist item

recoveryScenarios: Wishlist GET should join back to current product status - verified via contract engine, not simulated here
idempotencyExpectations: Adding an already-wishlisted item should not create duplicate rows (unique constraint expected on (customer_id, product_id) - see state-engine schema evidence)

workflows.name: Customer purchase: cart -> checkout -> payment -> order
workflows.startingCondition: Cart has at least one in-stock, published variant.

steps.description: Coupon validated (optional)
Checkout submitted; COD gated by trust_badges.cod, prepaid requires an active Razorpay environment
Order + order_items rows created, server-repriced (never client-trusted)
COD: stock allocated immediately via FEFO RPC; Prepaid: stock NOT decremented yet
Prepaid only: a payment attempt is started
order_placed notification fires for COD orders immediately (prepaid waits for payment success)

failureScenarios: Prepaid checkout requested while no Razorpay environment is configured -> 503 before any order row is created
Concurrent checkouts racing for the last unit of stock -> FEFO allocation RPC rolls back and the order+order_items are deleted, not left dangling
recoveryScenarios: Order/order_items cleanup on allocation failure (server/src/routes/public.js checkout handler)
idempotencyExpectations: Not applicable to order creation itself - each POST creates one order; idempotency matters downstream at payment verification (see payment.webhook_idempotency)

workflows.name: Prepaid payment verification -> order acceptance
workflows.startingCondition: A payment attempt exists for a prepaid order (status INITIATED/PENDING).

steps.description: Checkout.js callback posts the signed payment result
Razorpay webhook independently confirms the same payment (HMAC verified, may arrive before or after step 1)
webhook_events row records the event for idempotency (unique on gateway+event_id)
On confirmed SUCCESS, stock is allocated (first time only) and order marked paid
Retry a failed prepaid payment, capped

failureScenarios: Checkout.js callback and the Razorpay webhook both arrive for the same payment
Customer retries a failed payment beyond the Phase 9B cap of 10 attempts/order
recoveryScenarios: webhook_events unique(gateway,event_id) constraint prevents double-processing a replayed webhook
idempotencyExpectations: Stock must be allocated exactly once per order regardless of how many times SUCCESS is reported (verify-callback vs webhook race)
workflows.existingCoverage: server/dev-harness/test-phase9b-payment-retry-cap.js already exercises the retry cap against a real dev environment; Guardian references it rather than re-simulating live Razorpay traffic.

workflows.name: Admin order processing -> shipment -> customer visibility

steps.description: Admin views the order (with payment + batch allocation trail)
Admin creates a shipment for the order
Shipment status transitions are recorded with previous/new status pairs
orders.status is now driven exclusively by the shipment lifecycle, not a direct admin edit
Customer notified on shipped/delivered/out-for-delivery/delivery-failed

failureScenarios: Admin attempts to cancel an order that already has an active shipment past pre-dispatch
recoveryScenarios: Order cancel route redirects to the Shipment section's RTO flow instead of silently overriding status (server/src/routes/orders.js)
idempotencyExpectations: A second, near-simultaneous admin cancel request gets a 409 (conditional update on the read status), never a double-restock

workflows.name: Return request -> admin review -> refund -> inventory consequence
workflows.startingCondition: Order is 'delivered' and within the return-eligibility window.

steps.description: Customer requests a return on a delivered order
return_requests row created, status 'requested'
Admin reviews (approve/reject)
Approved item intake creates a new pending-QC batch
Admin processes the refund
refund recorded against the original payment
Customer notified of the outcome

failureScenarios: Refund amount exceeds the payment's remaining refundable balance
Return submitted after the 7-day eligibility window
recoveryScenarios: Refund amount is server-recomputed/re-validated, never client-trusted (Phase 9 audit §B)
idempotencyExpectations: Refund idempotency additionally keyed per gateway_refund_id so admin-initiated and webhook-confirmed paths never double-count

workflows.name: COD eligibility flag gates checkout end-to-end

steps.description: Admin updates the trust_badges setting
Storefront reads the same setting
Checkout must reject a COD order when the flag is off, independent of the client

failureScenarios: A direct API call bypassing the storefront UI attempts COD while the flag is off
recoveryScenarios: Server-side rejection independent of any client-side control (Phase 9B P1-3 fix)

workflows.name: Every /api/admin/* route requires staff auth + role permission

steps.description: Every admin route rejects an unauthenticated caller
Every mutating admin route is scoped by role permission, not just staff-ness

failureScenarios: A route file forgets router.use(requireStaffAuth) or a requirePermission() call

workflows.name: Every customer-owned-data route requires customer identity

steps.description: Every route that reads/writes req.customer-scoped data rejects an unauthenticated caller (hard middleware or inline guard)

failureScenarios: A route reads req.customer.id without checking req.customer is non-null first

workflows.name: New customer: discover -> purchase -> fulfillment -> delivery -> return -> refund -> final state

steps.description: Discover product via catalog
Purchase (see customer.checkout.purchase)
Admin sees and processes the order (see admin.order.fulfillment)
Shipment reaches 'delivered'
Customer requests a return (see customer.return.refund_cycle)
Refund reaches final state

failureScenarios: Any single composed workflow above breaking breaks this full lifecycle

workflows.name: Browse products by Concern / Benefit / Goal landing page
workflows.startingCondition: At least one published `categories` row of type concern/benefit/goal exists.

steps.description: List categories by type (mega-menu / filter sidebar source)
Category-scoped landing page (JSON API)
Category-scoped SSR landing page (/concern|/benefit|/goal)
Products tagged via the many-to-many join tables (Decision 1)

failureScenarios: A category slug with zero tagged products renders an empty-but-valid page, not an error
recoveryScenarios: Not applicable - read-only discovery, no state transition to recover

workflows.name: Browse products by Ingredient

steps.description: List all ingredients
Ingredient detail (JSON API)
Ingredient detail SSR page
Products tagged to this ingredient via the join table

failureScenarios: An ingredient with zero tagged products renders an empty-but-valid page, not an error

workflows.name: Compare up to 4 products side by side
workflows.startingCondition: Customer has selected 2+ published product ids to compare.

steps.description: Fetch comparable attribute set for the selected product ids
Compare page (client-rendered)
Only published products are comparable

failureScenarios: Product ids that don't exist or aren't published must be rejected/excluded, not silently comparing stale data

workflows.name: Read global FAQs and Knowledge Hub (blog) articles
workflows.startingCondition: At least one published `faqs`/`blog_posts` row exists (both render a valid empty state otherwise).

steps.description: Global FAQ list (JSON API)
Global FAQ SSR page
Knowledge Hub article list SSR page
Knowledge Hub article detail SSR page
FAQs persisted with a status gate (draft never leaks publicly)

failureScenarios: A draft FAQ or blog post must never appear on the public list/detail page

workflows.name: Admin manages Concerns/Benefits/Goals, Ingredients and FAQs
workflows.startingCondition: Staff is authenticated with the manageProducts permission.

steps.description: Staff auth required for every admin discovery-content route
manageProducts permission gates writes (categories/ingredients/faqs)
Create/update a category (concern/benefit/goal)
Create/update an ingredient
Create/update/publish a FAQ
FAQ publish transition

failureScenarios: A staff account without manageProducts must not be able to create/edit/delete a category, ingredient, or FAQ
recoveryScenarios: Not applicable - CRUD admin surface, no multi-step transaction to recover
idempotencyExpectations: PUT/update by id is naturally idempotent; POST create is not (each call creates a new row, expected)
